messages:
sam: quick q — small chore: bumped README example and fixed a comment. do we want a patch tag or skip?
release-bot: autodetect: change classified as 'docs' -> suggested release_type: patch? :thinking_face: (run /release-check to confirm)
sam: thanks. surprised it's flagged patch — docs-only used to be skip, right?
maria: historically we skip docs-only for semver unless it touches public API examples. does that apply here?
jordan: it's only snippet text, no API shape change. I'd vote skip.
alyssa: aggree w/ jordan. main risk is consumers depending on example wording — unlikely. prefer not to churn versions.
sam: deploy-bot generated changelog shows the file in 'public/examples'. that's the reason for patch suggestion.
deploy-bot: detected path: docs/examples/*.md. default rule: docs under public/ -> patch. override via `--release-skip` tag.
maria: hmm. maybe we tighten rule: only docs under api/ or sdk/ auto patch; examples/ should be docs-only skip.
jordan: SGTM. but for this PR do we bump now or skip and adjust rule?
alyssa: my vote: skip now, adjust rule in next infra PR to avoid repeats.
sam: +1 to skip. i'll add `#release:skip` to the PR and note change-window: none.
maria: can we also add a quick release note line "docs: clarify example" when the next actual patch rolls? small traceability is fine.
jordan: agree. if someone later wants to include it in a patch we can.
release-bot: action: label applied: release:skip by @sam. note: deploy automation will not create a patch for this change.
sam: putting a short note in PR and tagging @eng-releases so ops is aware. thanks all. :thumbsup:
alyssa: can someone file infra issue to update rule? that will save noise.
maria: I'll open infra ticket after standup. mention `deploy-bot` rule: docs/public/examples -> skip.
sam: closing loop: PR marked skip, no version bump, ticket #1234 to follow.
deploy-bot: FYI scheduled rollout of rule-change: next-week canary window. will announce in #eng-releases prior to merge.
jordan: perfect.
